candidates.statement: Let us recall the definition; but to simplify matters (and because here we are interested in the commutative situation), we shall state it for a commutative ring $A$.
However, in the paper itself we must deal with noncommutative DG rings, as explained in Subsection \ref{subsec:proofs}.

Even though our motivation is the squaring operation for commutative rings, we develop the squaring operation more generally for commutative DG rings, and this is the way we shall present the results in the Introduction.
